clue.text: Make very hungry fellow join Mennonite sect

parts.note: the Amish are a traditionalist Mennonite sect

explanation.surface: A fellow joins a strict religious community whose plain diet leaves him ravenous.
explanation.walkthrough: The Amish are a Protestant group, mostly in Pennsylvania, known for shunning modern technology.
explanation.definitionFit: To famish is to starve someone, depriving them of food until they are extremely hungry.

clue.text: Always splits into two bags to go climbing

clue.text: Lose an opportunity with atheist mobs in revolt

clue.text: Affects things done about boxing at university

clue.text: Repeat from memory in conversation about pressure causing temporary delay
